about_the_game:
Petmancer – A Roguelite Dungeon Crawler with Magical Pets

Master the art of Petmancy in a pixelated roguelite adventure where strategy meets whimsy. Explore mysterious dungeons, recruit powerful familiars, and outwit your enemies in turn-based battles. Whether you’re commanding an army of enchanted animals or auto-exploring the depths of the dungeons, Petmancer offers an endlessly replayable journey full of charm, challenge, and discovery.

Roguelite Replayability

No two runs are the same! Procedurally generated dungeons offer unique layouts, enemies, and loot every time you play.

Summon a Party of Pets

Recruit fierce and whimsical creatures—living and otherwise—to fight by your side. Each pet brings unique abilities and personalities to your party.

16 Unique Hero Classes

From Necromancers to Clairvoyants, choose your playstyle and unlock powerful synergies between talents, pets, and relics.

Turn-Based Combat Meets Auto Exploration

Plan every move in tactical battles or let your team explore on their own in idle mode—perfect for casual and hardcore players alike.

Unlock Ancient Talents

Mix and match 16 magical talents like Mind Control, Chronomancy, and Chaos to build your own strategy.

Prestige & Progression

Defeat the 7 Archmages to unlock new meta-abilities, bosses, and realms. Keep your pets, relics, and talents across runs for true long-term growth.

Explore 14 Themed Realms

Battle through shrines, fountains, secret rooms, and more in handcrafted environments like Vampire Castles, Underworld Crypts, and the chaotic Astral Spire.
